name: backlog-reconnect
about: Bob stands next to Alice and loses his connection from 100 s to 160 s while his phone keeps recording. The minute of backlog arrives in one tick and is accepted: its contacts fill Alice's lock window, and Bob is present again. Before, every batch more than 20 s older than the tick's median was rejected for clock skew. The gap still leaked his cell at 150 s and counted as dark time.
